file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

67	- Chief Legal Officer (Anne Hoge): legal/head -> legal/c_level.
68	- Vice President, Total Rewards (Seok Lee): other/vp -> people/vp.
69	- Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary (Lucas Moskowitz): legal/head -> legal/vp (to match SVP convention used for Rao and Kerbrat), or make the SVP rule explicit.
70	- Chief Legal Officer (Dan Gallagher): update title_raw to "Chief Legal, Compliance and Corporate Affairs Officer" (legal/c_level).
71	- Borderline, no change required without a rule: Jordan Sinclair and Matt Billings (subsidiary "President" mapped to vp), Deepak Rao function=marketing (four-scope GM), Stephanie Guild function=other (investment/finance), Ravi Mehta and Pooja Anand function=other (credit/risk, finance?), Kelly Zigaitis and Norm Ashkenas (subsidiary-level CCOs mapped c_level).
72	- Baiju Bhatt founder row is_current=false -> true (present-tense "is a Co-Founder... board member" on investors site).
73	
74	## Pipeline bugs suspected (patterns, not one-offs)
75	1. **is_current=false inferred from absence in the proxy.** The 2026-04-22 proxy lists only named executive officers, so absence is not evidence of departure. 11 roles use this rule (Chennapragada, Bhatt x3, Howard COO, Southwick, Smedley, Brown, Modica, Ashkenas, Zigaitis, Kerbrat CTO). The outcome is probably true for most but unsupported by any text. Only Warnick, Pinner and Hoge have an explicit departure statement. Use "unknown"/as_of rather than false, or require explicit evidence.
76	2. **Stale single-source roles left is_current=true** (Wolff 2020, Seigle 2021, Brown VP 2021). The pipeline notes the staleness in `note` but still outputs true, and these count toward people_current=25. Three of 25 "current" people are not supported as current (12% error in current headcount).
77	3. **Rejected evidence silently corrupts as_of/currency.** Bhatt's 2024-03-21 release lists him as CCO and Co-Founder but the claim was rejected ("evidence does not state an affiliation with Robinhood"), so the newest as_of is 2022 and he looks departed. The affiliation check is too strict for press-release boilerplate where the company is implied by the page.
78	4. **Title selection prefers older/higher-priority source over the newest title.** Gallagher: stored "Chief Legal Officer" despite the 2026 proxy and investors page giving the longer current title (company_site priority beats sec_filing regardless of date). Recency should outweigh source priority for titles.
79	5. **Undated S-1/A (2021) treated as current.** Its title facts (Tenev, Bhatt, Smedley, etc.) have published_at=null and is_current=true even though the content is 2021 (ages 34/36/44...). Search-source documents need a date or an is_current=null default.
80	6. **Fact-level is_current stays true on superseded facts** (e.g. Pinner 2024 release/proxy facts true while the 8-K says separated). Role-level resolution is correct but the fact rows are misleading; review block "resolved: false" for Pinner, Warnick and Hoge is out of date.
81	7. **Bio and location extraction quality.** Bio picks anecdotes or prior-employer sentences (Tenev "born in Bulgaria", Bazzano's Gap years); location "San Francisco" from an interviewer's line.
82	8. **Blocked host dependence.** 12 of the 25 current people have investors.robinhood.com (403) as their only live-verifiable source; cached text supports them, but they need a browser re-check before release.
